mentions.name: World Watcher
mentions.description: This app is an interactive world map of livecam streams that are publicly available on YouTube, letting users seamlessly jump from place to place without opening new pages to watch each stream. It supports filtering streams by type of place or features, such as beaches or cams with audio, and includes an Explore button for discovering where to go. Planned work includes automating the process of finding and inserting new streams onto the map.
mentions.problem: Existing livecam aggregators with maps are unsatisfying because they always require you to open new pages to watch the streams.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm still working on World Watcher (https://worldwatcher.live). It's an interactive map of livecams around the world.

The idea is to have a better experience for navigating livecam streams that are publicly available on YouTube.
